headline: On November 26, 2011: Mars Science Laboratory launches with Curiosity Rover
captionCards: Enabled long-term study of Martian geology and climate
instagramCaption:
Curiosity launched on a mission to Mars.

NASA's Mars Science Laboratory lifted off on November 26, 2011, carrying the Curiosity rover. It landed in Gale Crater on August 6, 2012. The rover carries scientific instruments built by an international team. Its mission includes studying Mars’s habitability and climate.

It paved the way for future human exploration of Mars.
